durable_job_shape_check.name: durable_job_shape_check
durable_job_shape_check.value:
("durable_job"."kind" = 'agent_turn' and "durable_job"."conversation_id" is not null and "durable_job"."run_id" is null)
        or
        ("durable_job"."kind" = 'lab_run' and "durable_job"."run_id" is not null and "durable_job"."conversation_id" is null)

lse_loss_reason_ck.name: lse_loss_reason_ck
lse_loss_reason_ck.value: "lead_stage_event"."to_stage_kind" <> 'lost' OR "lead_stage_event"."approximate" = true OR "lead_stage_event"."loss_reason" IS NOT NULL
